title: Graph neural network screening finds one PPARgamma agonist among five natural products
summary: A graph attention network (best of GCN, GAT and MPNN) screened 4,112 ZINC natural products for PPARgamma agonism, passing 291 candidates to docking and ADMET evaluation, after which five compounds were tested in vitro. Glycyrrhisoflavone showed concentration-dependent agonist activity with EC50 9.98 uM, while the other four were weak. Only one of five tested compounds was active, evidence is in vitro only and the hit is a known natural product rather than a new scaffold.
ai_technology: Graph attention network (chosen among GCN, GAT and MPNN) screening natural products for PPARgamma agonism
